Purpose: Confirms the test specification is derived from an approved customer/product requirement
Example Evidence: Source requirement IDs and revision recorded

Purpose: Prevents test conditions from becoming detached from validation obligations
Example Evidence: Every in-scope validation requirement linked to the spec

Purpose: Ensures pass/fail can be determined without subjective interpretation
Example Evidence: Numeric limits, categorical condition or explicit acceptance rule

Purpose: Defines population, genealogy, conditioning and availability assumptions
Example Evidence: DUT count, groups, serialisation and readiness gate

Purpose: Confirms each required test method exists or has an explicit development task
Example Evidence: Released method ID/revision or linked development plan

Purpose: Confirms the controlled test basis is approved before laboratory commitment
Example Evidence: Review completed and status set to Released
